{{Top|leg}}
'''Cloaked mines''' were a type of [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] equipped with a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] derived from [[Nagai/Legends|N'Gai]] technology. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Zeta Magnus]] blockaded the planet [[Skye/Legends|Marat V]] with a cloaked minefield. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigate]] ''[[Golandras]]'' arrived to render aid to the plague-stricken world, it ran directly through the invisible minefield and exploded.
